meta.title: Catch And Tame weather events data

sources.label: Catch And Tame! Wiki - Weather Events

meta.notes: The standalone Catch and Tame wiki lists 14 current weather rows. Fandom and BloxInformer are used as cross-checks, but older or alternate labels such as Tsunami, Tacos, Disco, Sand Tornado, Blossom, Cats Vs Dogs, Galaxy, and Abducted are not added as separate rows unless they are part of the current 14-row weather table.

items.name: Sunny
items.mainEffect: Default weather state with no special weather bonus.
items.bestUse: Use this downtime for normal catching, combining, selling, and preparing pets before stronger weather starts.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean row-specific weather image found in inspected sources

items.name: Rainy
items.activation: Normal weather cycle or Rain Totem
items.duration: About 10 minutes when forced by a totem
items.mutation: Higher mutated-animal chance; no named mutation listed
items.mainEffect: Raises luck, makes animals easier to catch, and improves the chance of larger or mutated animals spawning.
items.bestUse: A useful early farming window when you want easier catches without waiting for rarer weather.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Rain weather icon

items.name: Aurora Borealis
items.activation: Normal weather cycle or Aurora Totem
items.duration: About 10 minutes when forced by a totem
items.mutation: Higher mutated-animal chance; no named mutation listed
items.mainEffect: Greatly raises luck and improves the chance of rare and mutated animals spawning.
items.bestUse: Save eggs, hatch attempts, and serious catching routes for this weather when possible.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Aurora Borealis weather icon

items.name: Thunderstorm
items.duration: About 10 minutes when forced by a totem
items.mainEffect: Can apply Charged to pen pets and can spawn Lightning Dragon on Dragon Island.
items.bestUse: Best when your pen already has pets worth upgrading and you can check Dragon Island during the weather window.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Thunderstorm weather effect screenshot

items.name: Cosmic Shower
items.duration: About 10 minutes when forced by a totem
items.mainEffect: Drops meteors that can provide Cosmic Fruits and can apply Cosmic to pen pets.
items.bestUse: Strong for players chasing both a mutation route and a rare Sky Island spawn in the same window.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean row-specific weather image found in inspected sources

items.name: Underwater
items.mainEffect: Floods the map, lets players swim through the air, and creates a high chance for a Water Mythic spawn.
items.bestUse: Use the mobility change to scan the map quickly while watching for the Water Mythic window.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom uses the alternate label Tsunami
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Underwater weather effect screenshot

items.name: Volcanic Eruption
items.mainEffect: Can apply Volcanic to pen pets; Volcanic-mutated pets can randomly grant Legendary Lucky Blocks.
items.bestUse: Most useful when you want Magma Dragon near the Volcano or passive Lucky Block value from Volcanic pets.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean row-specific weather image found in inspected sources

items.name: Bloodmoon
items.mainEffect: Spawns Bloodmoon Grapes for Bloodbound and activates the Bloodmoon Spin Wheel.
items.bestUse: Prioritize strong pets for Bloodmoon Grapes, and bring help if you are trying to catch Boss Hydra.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom event cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Bloodmoon weather screenshot

items.name: Gravebound
items.mainEffect: Enables Skeletal Mutation Machine progress and can randomly apply Fractured to pen pets.
items.bestUse: Treat it as a planned mutation-machine window rather than a general luck event.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer skeleton-event cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from BloxInformer Skeleton/Gravebound event screenshot

items.name: Valentine's
items.activation: Normal weather cycle during the event route
items.mainEffect: Allows identical-pet combining for Cupid and Chocolate Heart feeding for Lovestruck.
items.bestUse: Best when you already have duplicate pets or event items ready before the weather appears.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom event cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom Love Machine screenshot tied to the Valentine weather combine-pets mechanic

items.name: Admin Cloud
items.mainEffect: Can apply Admin to pen pets during rare admin-triggered weather.
items.bestUse: Treat it as opportunistic bonus value because it is not a normal farming route.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom admin-weather cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean row-specific weather image found in inspected sources

items.name: Sandstorm
items.duration: About 10 minutes when forced by a totem
items.mainEffect: Increases desert animal spawns and can spawn Basilisk, Griffin, and Camel.
items.bestUse: Plan around location and lasso power because Basilisk needs a strong lasso and Griffin is tied to Sky Island.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Sandstorm weather effect screenshot

items.name: Blizzard
items.exclusivePets: Yeti, Polar Bear, Penguin, Christmas Dragon, Mammoth, Festive Penguin
items.mainEffect: Raises snow-biome animal spawns, can apply Frozen to pen pets, and opens the Yeti spawn window.
items.bestUse: Useful when you are farming snow-area animals and want Frozen mutation chances at the same time.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: local image collected from Fandom row-specific Blizzard weather banner screenshot

items.name: Snowy
items.exclusivePets: Christmas Dragon, Mammoth, Polar Bear, Festive Penguin
items.mainEffect: Spawns Christmas seasonal animals, can apply Frozen, and gives a 1.5x Candy bonus.
items.bestUse: Best during seasonal progress when Candy and Christmas animal spawns matter more than general luck.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean Snowy-specific weather image found in inspected sources
